GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

   A. A mixture of two liquids
